stories.title: Tesla's new Roadster does a kickflip over a Semi
stories.summary: At the Roadster unveiling at SpaceX's test site in McGregor, Texas, Tesla's new car drove up a curved ramp until it hung upside down, then used cold-gas thrusters to leap off flat ground and barrel-roll over a Model 3, Model Y, Cybertruck, Cybercab and Semi before landing on its wheels. Tesla's "Do a kickflip!" clip got 206K likes, and the reaction was immediate: "we got flying cars before GTA 6" (Rockstar had dropped the GTA 6 launch trailer the same day), Knight Rider turbo-boost comparisons, AI edits of Roadsters hopping over traffic and police checkpoints, and arguments over whether the footage was CGI.
